web.label: Web research
web.description: Web search and page fetching: library and API documentation, release notes and version facts, known bugs, standards, prior art.

toolDescriptions.web_search: Search the web for documentation, release notes, known bugs, and prior art.
toolDescriptions.fetch_content: Fetch and read a specific web page, PDF, GitHub repository, or video transcript.
toolDescriptions.get_search_content: Re-read stored content from an earlier web search or fetch.

mcp.label: MCP servers
mcp.description: Connected MCP servers (Context7 docs, Paperless documents, a Chrome browser, TabPFN predictions on tabular data, Vercel docs, projects, deployments, and logs).

marimo.label: Marimo notebooks
marimo.description: Run Python in a live marimo notebook kernel with the marimo-pair skill to inspect notebook variables, dataframes, cells, and outputs, and with the marimo-lens skill to read the user's Lens selections and notes on rendered outputs. Useful when the task involves a marimo notebook or data loaded in a running notebook session. Code runs in the kernel, so it could change notebook state.

jev.label: Jev judgments
jev.description: Ask TypeSafe's Jev typed questions (yes/no, multiple choice, or a score on a rubric) about text or data and get probabilities back, via the TypeSafe System One API. Useful when the task builds, tunes, or evaluates a TypeSafe/Jev integration and the plan should rest on how Jev actually answers sample inputs; not useful otherwise. Pass the request as JSON in a quoted heredoc; `~/.local/bin/jev-ask --help` shows the format.
